County.metaDescription: Courthouses and how to ask for traffic school in {county} County, California. Demo data: check with your court.
County.demoNotice: Demo data — check with your court
County.title: {county} County Superior Court
County.instructionsHeading: How to ask for traffic school
County.howBody: Contact the {county} County Superior Court, or use its website, and ask whether your violation is eligible for traffic school. Keep your citation in hand.
County.deadlineBody: Your citation lists a due date. Ask the court to confirm it in writing before you start, and finish the course before that date.
County.citationBody: The citation number is printed on your ticket, usually near the top. Courts use it to find your case.
County.caseLookup: Look up your case on the court website
County.ctaBody: Take the course online, in the language you read best.
